category: Application Library examples: LiveLink for Inventor
description: Ready-made, documented example simulations installed with the LiveLink for Inventor. Each lists its physics interfaces, couplings and study steps; solve one with comsol_run_example or adapt its Java build script.

tools.name: Electrical Heating in a Busbar Assembly [LiveLink for Inventor example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the LiveLink for Inventor (Tutorials, LiveLink Interface): Electrical Heating in a Busbar Assembly. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.
tools.usage: MCP: comsol_run_example("LiveLink_for_Inventor/Tutorials,_LiveLink_Interface/busbar_llinventor") to solve it, comsol_example_info("busbar_llinventor", include_java=true) for its build script. COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > LiveLink for Inventor > Tutorials, LiveLink Interface > busbar llinventor
tools.notes: Library path LiveLink_for_Inventor/Tutorials,_LiveLink_Interface/busbar_llinventor; model file 1.1 MB. Requires the module licence to open and solve.
